entry.title: CVE-2026-129289 CRITICAL
entry.summary:
PHP-FPM request smuggling through an unread HTTP request body.
PHP does not discard the unread part of an HTTP request body at request shutdown when the application has opened php://input without reading it to the end. entry.title: CVE-2026-129291 HIGH
entry.summary:
PHP-FPM epoll use-after-free can lead to local privilege escalation.
When catch_workers_output is enabled and the epoll event backend is used, the PHP-FPM master can close a worker's output pipe in fpm_child_close() without removing the associated event, and the delayed cleanup can free the worker record while its epoll registration is still active.
